mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and electrolyte disturbances (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia); sirolimus is nephrotoxic and zoledronic acid is nephrotoxic with risk of acute kidney injury, creating additive renal and metabolic complications.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR, creatinine) and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate) regularly; ensure adequate hydration before zoledronic acid infusion; consider alternative bisphosphonates if renal function declines.
